title: Transfer of Development Rights (TDR)
applicability: TDR provisions apply only to prospective development. Development Rights Certificates (DRCs) are transferable negotiable instruments issued by the MCGM Commissioner.

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Full DP-reserved plot for public purpose surrendered free of cost to MCGM
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA = Zonal (basic) FSI of surrendered land + BUA equal to plot area of surrendered land
conditions: Land not yet handed over and FSI benefit not availed on remainder plot, no TDR/monetary compensation availed
No award declared under Section 23 of Right to Fair Compensation Act 2013

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Inclusive Housing (Reg 15) / Amenity Open Space (Reg 14) / Cotton Textile Mills (Reg 35) surrender
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA = Zonal (basic) FSI of surrendered land
conditions: Only if FSI benefit is not availed on remainder plot and no TDR previously availed

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: DP Roads / RL under MMC Act / River widening / major Nalla widening surrendered to MCGM
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA = Zonal (basic) FSI of surrendered land + BUA equal to plot area of surrendered land
conditions: Only if FSI benefit is not availed on development proposal and not proposed on remainder plot

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Subsequent road widening / proposed DP road / right-of-way to land-locked plot (Reg 22)
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA = Zonal (basic) FSI of surrendered land (or adjoining SDZ-II zone)
conditions: Applies where development is complete or not proposed

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Reservation developed under AR provisions with unconsumed zonal FSI due to planning constraints
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA = plot area of surrendered land + BUA in lieu of construction of built-up amenity

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: BUA in lieu of cost of construction of built-up amenity to be handed over (Reg 14/15/17)
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: As per Construction Amenity TDR formula below

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Cessed bldg 33(7)/33(7)(B), Urban Renewal 33(8), Cluster 33(9), Slum Rehab 33(10), Rental Housing 33(11)
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: As prescribed under the specific scheme's DCPR provisions

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Affordable/Rental Housing on unreserved private land, entire plot + tenements handed over free (Reg 33(20))
Heritage buildings (Reg 52) where redevelopment not permitted
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: TDR = (Zonal FSI BUA + plot area on which heritage structure exists) − existing BUA of heritage building
conditions: With MHCC recommendation and Commissioner permission
Plot potential permanently reduced by existing BUA

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Encumbered plots urgently required for public projects
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: 50% of BUA per Zonal FSI for encumbered portion (project authority certifies vacant vs encumbered demarcation)

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Unreserved accessible plot (not in NDZ/SDZ) offered voluntarily for public purpose (POS/SWM/Chowky/PSC)
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA = Zonal FSI + plot area equivalent

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Reserved DP-road/public-purpose land in N-SDZ-II, accessible from existing road
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: 0.8 × land area + BUA per Zonal FSI of adjoining zone + plot area equivalent

generation_instances_table_12A.instance: Roads / uninterrupted access to SH/POS/OA handed over under Reg 33(8)
generation_instances_table_12A.tdr_extent_formula: BUA equal to area of land surrendered

tdr_multipliers_for_dp_road_reservation_.note: Multiplier applied to surrendered land area to compute TDR quantum. Reduced ratio (2.35 / 1.85) applies where fencing/compound wall construction is not permissible.

incentive_tdr_early_submission.description: Additional/incentive TDR as percentage of surrendered land area for early submission

variables.X: Permissible TDR utilization on receiving plot (sqm)
variables.Rg: ASR land rate (Rs/sqm) of generating plot in the generating year
variables.Rr: ASR land rate (Rs/sqm) of receiving plot in the generating year

utilization_formula.note: All TDR including slum TDR and heritage TDR shall be utilized as per this formula only. If multiple ASR rates apply on receiving plot, use weighted average.

variables.A: Cost of construction of amenity in Rs, per ASR construction rates for the year construction commences
variables.B: Land rate per sqm per ASR for the year construction commences

not_permitted_in: Coastal areas, NDZ, SDZ, TDAs, Green Zone, SPA areas (MMRDA/MIDC/MHADA)
Slum plots / cessed plots under Reg 33(7)/(9)/(10) — except amalgamated non-slum plots with SRA/MHADA NOC
Proposals utilizing special-FSI provisions unless otherwise specified
Industrial Zone with only hazardous activity
Heritage buildings/precincts (Reg 52), except with MHCC approval

issued_after: Land surrendered free of cost and encumbrances to MCGM/State Govt
Land levelled to surrounding ground level
1.5 m compound wall (or as stipulated by Commissioner) with gate constructed at owner's cost
issuance_procedure.transfer: DRC transfer requires Commissioner's endorsement with registered agreement between original and new holder
issuance_procedure.lessor_compensation: For leased land: lessee must pay lessor (or deposit with Planning Authority) the value of lessor's interest per Land Acquisition Act 1894 / RFCTLARR 2013

cross_references.reg_30_mandatory_slum_tdr: Reg 30(A)(6) — min 20% / max 50% of admissible TDR from slum redevelopment must be utilized
cross_references.reg_31_fungible_over_and_above: Fungible FSI is over-and-above TDR + additional-FSI-premium, subject to permissible FSI cap
